pages.title: Brownian Microscope
pages.text: A microscope over a drop of water with clay in it. The grains never stop jittering - molecules strike them from every side - and how far they wander weighs the molecules.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Hold the cell's temperature with the coolant (water stays liquid between 273 and 370 K; its viscosity falls steeply as it warms). Choose how long between frames and how many tracks to follow: the error in Avogadro's number falls as √(2/n), and the objective's resolution must be fine against how far a grain wanders in that time.

pages.name: Brownian Microscope
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
